title: How we quote today
summary: Every quote is measured on site by the owner, priced at night in Excel, then retyped into Word by the office. Follow-up depends on memory.

detail.what: Most enquiries ring the owner's mobile; the rest come through the website form to the shared inbox. Anything under $500 or over an hour's drive is turned down on the spot.
rules: Skip jobs more than an hour from Hornsby
goes_wrong: Calls taken on a ladder get written on a scrap of paper and lost

options.label: Builder
options.note: Measure off the plans they email

detail.what: Homeowners always get a site visit. Builders send plans and a finishes schedule; those are measured off the drawings, no visit.
rules: Builder work is priced 10% sharper and paid on 30-day terms

detail.what: Walks every room, measures walls and ceilings, notes the condition and counts doors, frames and windows. Photos of anything tricky.
rules: Measure wall length × height, less openings over 2 m²
Note the year built: pre-1980 means extra prep
goes_wrong: Measurements in the Notes app are in a different order from the Excel template
odd_cases: Occupied house with furniture: allow a day's moving
detail.source: Your answers to Q8 and Q9

detail.what: Types each room's measurements into the Excel template, which multiplies by the rates. Then adds prep, rubbish, scaffold and a rounding to the nearest $50.
rules: Ceilings $12/m², doors and frames $85 each (example rates)
Round the total up to the nearest $50
goes_wrong: Rates in the template are from 2024; the newer ones are only in the owner's head
Forgot scaffold on the Pennant Hills job and wore $600
detail.source: Your workings for quote Q-1043 and the price list

detail.what: The partner copies one line per room from Excel into the Word quote template, adds the inclusions and exclusions, and saves it as a PDF with the next quote number.
rules: Customer sees a price per room and one total, inc GST
Never show rates, prep % or the scaffold mark-up
Quote valid 30 days, 20% deposit to book
goes_wrong: Room names don't match between Excel and Word, so a room gets missed

detail.what: The owner reads the PDF on their phone, the partner emails it to the customer from the shared inbox.
goes_wrong: Waits a day or two for the owner to check it

detail.what: A call a week or so later, if the owner remembers. There's no list of open quotes.
goes_wrong: Lost Q-1051 to a cheaper quote that came in while nobody had followed up

options.label: Won
options.note: Deposit invoice in Xero, job booked

detail.what: Won jobs get a deposit invoice in Xero and a date on the wall calendar. Lost quotes aren't recorded anywhere, so there's no win rate.

first_skill.name: Your quoting assistant
first_skill.what: Send it your site notes and photos; it prices them on your rates and lays out the quote the way you send it. You check it and send.
